coordinate_system: Same as model.stl and parts/*.stl. X = ruler length, Y = width, Z = thickness / print direction (bed at z = 0). All files are in the fully unfolded 0 deg pose.
angle_definition: 0 deg = adjacent segments in a straight line (unfolded, as exported); 180 deg = child folded back alongside the parent.

joints.name: joint_1
joints.fold_direction: Positive rotation about the axis direction (+Z, counter-clockwise seen from above). parts_2 swings toward +Y and at 180 deg lies on the +Y side of parts_1 with a 0.5 mm side gap.
joints.child_transform: rotate parts_2 (and everything downstream) by +angle about axis_direction through axis_origin
joints.axial_retention: up: ring of parts_2 (top z=2.4) under cap of parts_1 (bottom z=2.8); down: 49.4 deg conical flange on pin (r 3.2 at z=0) under matching cone in parts_2 hole (min r 2.5)

joints.name: joint_2
joints.fold_direction: Positive rotation about the axis direction (-Z, i.e. clockwise seen from above, relative to parts_2). parts_3 swings toward the -Y side of parts_2 and at 180 deg lies alongside parts_2 (Z-fold) with a 0.5 mm side gap.
joints.child_transform: rotate parts_3 by +angle about axis_direction through axis_origin, applied in the frame of parts_2 (i.e. after the joint_1 transform)
joints.axial_retention: up: ring of parts_3 (top z=2.4) under cap of parts_2 (bottom z=2.8); down: 49.4 deg conical flange on pin under matching cone in parts_3 hole

independent_motion: Each joint has its own pin and its own 0..180 deg range; the two joints are mechanically independent. World pose of parts_3 = R_joint1(a1) * R_joint2(a2).
hard_stops: Measured with verify.py: below 0 deg the segment end faces collide at about -2.4 deg; above 180 deg the side faces collide at about 180.8 deg (natural end stops).
